prompt:
You run weekly onboarding A/B tests. Here is every finished test so far: what you predicted
and what was measured.

- round 1: Move Sign-In After Pet Adoption [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +12.0%, measured +13.3% (p=0.0), won
- round 1: Interactive Desktop Waiting Room [home, redesign]: predicted +8.0%, measured +5.6% (p=0.005388), won
- round 1: Photo Quality Guide & Companion Preview [adoption, incentive]: predicted +10.0%, measured +7.6% (p=0.00564), won
- round 2: Move Sign-In to Onboarding Hand-off [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +13.3%, measured +2.1% (p=0.167632), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Simplified Onboarding Path Selection Copy [choose_path, copy]: predicted +6.5%, measured +0.1% (p=0.976535), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Live 3D Render Hatching Progress Tracker [home, wait_info]: predicted +5.6%, measured +1.7% (p=0.401958), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Move Sign-In After Waiting Room [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +7.0%, measured -3.9% (p=0.003353), lost: worse
- round 3: Pick Friend Compact Grid Layout [adoption, layout]: predicted +7.0%, measured -7.7% (p=0.002297), lost: worse
- round 3: Choose Path Clarity Headline Update [choose_path, copy]: predicted +1.0%, measured +5.9% (p=2.8e-05), won
- round 3: Waiting Completion Desktop Sound Notification [home, notification]: predicted +3.0%, measured +2.2% (p=0.148091), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: System Tray Location & Shortcut Notification Tip [finish, notification]: predicted +7.5%, measured +3.8% (p=0.194133), won, confirmed by re-test

Previous lessons:
Moving sign-in until after pet adoption was effective and slightly outperformed predictions (+13.3% measured vs +12.0% predicted), but moving sign-in to onboarding hand-off showed no clear effect.
Home page redesigns like interactive waiting rooms were helpful (+5.6% measured), though predictions were too high (+8.0% predicted).
Adoption incentives like photo quality guides and companion previews were helpful (+7.6% measured), but were overestimated (+10.0% predicted).
Simplifying onboarding path selection copy showed no clear effect.
Adding live 3D render hatching progress trackers to the home page showed no clear effect.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and underpredicted (+13.3% vs +12.0%), but moving it to hand-off showed no clear effect and moving it after the waiting room made results worse (-3.9%).
Home redesigns like interactive waiting rooms were helpful (+5.6%), though predictions were too high (+8.0%).
Adoption incentives were helpful (+7.6%), but predictions were overestimated (+10.0%).
Path selection headline copy updates were helpful and underpredicted (+5.9% vs +1.0%), though general path copy simplification showed no clear effect.
Compact grid layouts for friend selection in adoption performed worse (-7.7%).
Live 3D render progress trackers and sound notifications showed no clear effect.
